name: Crystal Springs Reservoir
place: San Mateo County, on the San Francisco Peninsula

summary.value: A Peninsula storage reservoir in the regional water system; its water is treated at the Harry Tracy Water Treatment Plant along with the San Andreas supply.

headline: A 149-foot dam from 1888 holds water for the Peninsula in the valley of the San Andreas Fault.

facts.label: Water system
facts.value: Hetch Hetchy Regional Water System, serving 2.7 million customers
